versions.changelog: Fix display name to Freepik (was Freepik 1.0.0)
Allow curl downloads from *.freepik.com subdomains (CDN, docs)
Remove curl download and base64 tools to eliminate exfiltration vector
Harden allowed-tools: restrict curl to api.freepik.com, scope downloads to ~/.freepik/, remove unused Read/Write permissions
Declare FREEPIK_API_KEY as required env, fix ownerId mismatch, add homepage metadata

Initial release of Freepik skill — generate, edit, and search creative content with Freepik's AI API.

- Generate images, videos, icons, and audio using 50+ Freepik AI models, including Mystic, Flux, Runway, and Seedream.
- Supports advanced parameters: LoRA selection/training, reference images, several aspect ratios, high resolutions, and upscaling.
- Search and download Freepik stock images, videos, and audio.
- All API calls require a FREEPIK_API_KEY and handle authentication/async patterns.
- Clear error handling and download instructions for generated assets.
